hook: Inferact plans an autonomous inference system built around vLLM
hookText: Inferact plans an autonomous inference system built around vLLM

beats.say: vLLM co-creator Simon Mo explains that Inferact is building a system that tunes vLLM for new models, chips and workloads on its own, while vLLM stays open and engine improvements go back upstream.
In an X article, "Building an Autonomous Inference System", Mo argues that the model × hardware × workload space can't be tuned by hand.
Many people have asked what inferact is building and what it means for vllmproject.
